description: This file defines a Spring Data JPA repository interface for the Client entity, providing various query methods for retrieving clients based on different criteria such as name, address, user, creation date, status, and NIP.

classes.name: ClientRepository
classes.description: A Spring Data JPA repository interface for managing Client entities with custom query methods.

methods.name: findByNameIgnoreCase
methods.description: Finds a client by name, ignoring case.

methods.name: findByNameContainingIgnoreCaseOrderByNameAsc
methods.description: Finds clients whose names contain a specified string, ignoring case, ordered by name ascending.

methods.name: findByNameContainingIgnoreCaseAndAddressCityOrderByNameAsc
methods.description: Finds clients whose names contain a specified string and are located in a specified city, ignoring case, ordered by name.

methods.name: findByUser
methods.description: Finds clients associated with a specific user.

methods.name: findByUserOrderByNameAsc
methods.description: Finds clients associated with a specific user, ordered by name.

methods.name: findByUserIn
methods.description: Finds clients associated with any user in a list of users.

methods.name: findByCreatedAfter
methods.description: Finds clients created after a specific date.

methods.name: findByCreatedBetween
methods.description: Finds clients created between two dates.

methods.name: findByStatusAndAddressCityOrderByNameAsc
methods.description: Finds clients with a specific status and address city, ordered by name.

methods.name: findByStatusOrderByNameAsc
methods.description: Finds clients with a specific status, ordered by name.

methods.name: findByAddressCityOrderByNameAsc
methods.description: Finds clients in a specific city, ordered by name.

methods.name: findByAddressCityContainingIgnoreCaseOrderByNameAsc
methods.description: Finds clients with city names containing a string, ignoring case, ordered by name.

methods.name: findByAddressRegionOrderByNameAsc
methods.description: Finds clients in a specific region, ordered by name.

methods.name: findByNipContaining
methods.description: Finds clients with NIP containing a specific string.

calls: Spring Data JPA query derivation methods
